message.content:
**Columbia University** is an Ivy League research university located in New York City, United States. Founded in 1754 as King's College, it was renamed Columbia College in 1784 and later became Columbia University in 1896. It is one of the oldest institutions of higher education in the United States and has a long history of academic excellence. ### Key Facts | Item | Details | |------|---------| | **Location** | Morningside Heights, Manhattan, New York City (main campus). Additional campuses include the Columbia Business School in Midtown Manhattan, the Columbia Law School in Upper Manhattan, and the Columbia School of Social Work in Morningside Heights. | | **Founding Year** | 1754 (as King's College) | | **Type** | Private research university | | **Ivy League Member** | Yes | | **Student Body** | Approximately 30,000 students (undergraduate, graduate, professional, and doctoral programs) | | **Academic Structure** | • Columbia College (undergraduate)
• Graduate School of Arts & Sciences
• School of Engineering & Applied Science
• School of Journalism
• School of Public Health
• School of Social Work
• Columbia Law School
• Columbia Business School
• School of International and Public Affairs (SIPA)
• School of Medicine (NYU College of Dentistry, NYU College of Pharmacy, etc.) | | **Notable Alumni** | • Alexander Hamilton (founder of the U.S. Treasury)
• Barack Obama (former U.S. President)
• Ruth Bader Ginsburg (Supreme Court Justice)
• Toni Morrison (Nobel laureate)
• Andrew Carnegie (industrialist)
• Many other prominent figures in politics, law, literature, science, and business. | | **Research Highlights** | • Nobel Prize winners across multiple disciplines (e.g., chemistry, physics, economics, medicine).
• Strong emphasis on interdisciplinary research.
• Centers and institutes include the Center for Data Science, the Institute for Genomics and Stem Cell Biology, the Columbia Climate School, etc. | | **Campus Features** | • Historic buildings such as Low Memorial Library, Butler Library, and the iconic Morningside Hall.
• The campus is known for its blend of historic architecture and modern facilities.
• Located near Riverside Park and the Hudson River, providing scenic views and outdoor spaces. | | **Athletics** | NCAA Division I; teams known as the Columbia Lions. | ### Academic Reputation Columbia University consistently ranks among the top universities worldwide. It is renowned for its rigorous undergraduate program, distinguished faculty, and extensive research output. The university’s libraries, especially the Butler Library, are among the largest and most comprehensive in the world. ### Cultural and Historical Significance - **Historical Role**: Columbia played a pivotal role in American intellectual life, producing influential thinkers and leaders. - **Cultural Contributions**: The university hosts numerous cultural events, including lectures, performances, and exhibitions. - **Urban Engagement**: Its location in New York City allows for unique partnerships with businesses, NGOs, and governmental agencies. --- If you need more specific information—such as admission statistics, tuition costs, or details about particular departments—just let me know!
